content: DBOS Transact: durable execution as a library backed by the app's own Postgres, no external server (vs Temporal's externally orchestrated server requiring re-architecture). Workflow/step progress stored in Postgres; crash resumes from last successful step. Idempotency via workflow ID as idempotency key; optional caller-supplied idempotency key guarantees single execution. Transactional exactly-once: when a step writes to the same Postgres storing workflow state, the step's DB write and durability record commit atomically in one transaction -- closest philosophical peer to entflow's DB-step model.
